_doc: Render quality profiles (pipeline/render_fast.mjs --profile <name>). 'scale' multiplies the composition size (a 1080x1920 composition at 0.5 = 540x960). 'quality' is passed to scenes as inputProps.__quality so library scenes can pick shadow-map size / supersampling / post passes. Profile A is for checking story actions, B for approving timing and transitions, C for delivery.

quick.label: A - quick test
quick.note: 270x480 (exact even size); render only selected frames/short ranges
